question: Your smart motion sensor in the garden shed keeps dropping connection to your hub. What is the easiest fix?
explanation: Many smart home devices use mesh networks like Zigbee or Z-Wave. Battery-powered sensors don't repeat signals to save power, but mains-powered devices like smart plugs act as repeaters. Adding a smart plug midway extends the mesh network range without needing a new hub.
practical_challenge: Open your smart home app and identify which of your connected devices run on batteries versus wall power.
